race.name: Dwarf
race.physicalDescription: Compact, sturdy people renowned for endurance, craftsmanship, clan traditions, and settlements carved into stone.

appearance: Quiet and focused, wearing magnifying lenses and an apron full of tiny organized tools.
backstory: A clockmaker found an impossible mechanism hidden inside an ordinary repair job.
goals: Understand its maker and keep it away from patrons who want only military applications.

traits: Eager to forgive personal insults but incapable of overlooking harm done to a stranger.
Speaks in proverbs, most of which are invented on the spot and only loosely relevant.

racialTraits.physicalAbility: Thick-Skinned: Dwarfs dense skin provides modest natural protection, allowing them to withstand unarmed blows and minor impacts better than other species when not wearing armor.

rules.name: Mending RULE
rules.description: Repair simple breaks in non-living objects; missing material must be supplied and magical properties are not restored.

talents:
Athlete — +1 to physical actions involving sustained movement, climbing, or jumping.
Field Medic — +1 when stabilizing injuries or using mundane medical supplies.
equipment: Uncommon medium armor — Reliable professional armor balancing protection and mobility.
Hand axe — A compact chopping weapon balanced well enough to throw.
Rapier — A precise thrusting sword favoring Dexterity and careful footwork.
inventory: Bedroll — A weather-resistant blanket and sleeping roll.
Musical instrument — A portable instrument chosen to suit the character.
Herbalism pouch — Small tools and containers for gathering useful plants.
